svg.title: State sensing alone versus state plus rate (metabolic sensing)
svg.desc: Same disk_free signal viewed two ways. State alone shows current position only. State plus rate shows position and trajectory, allowing prediction of when a critical threshold will be reached.
svg.text: same disk_free signal · two ways of looking at it

g.text: "how things are and where they're going"
a system with only state is reactive — waits for the critical line to be crossed.
a system with state + rate is predictive — has time to act before the crossing.
this is what "metabolism" means in the engineering sense.
